evals.name: markdown-only-single-page
evals.prompt: Our ledger-sync repo needs to show up in the AbsaOSS knowledge base. Get the operator docs in docs/ published there.
evals.expected_output: Exactly one new file, .github/workflows/publish-docs.yml, calling AbsaOSS/knowledge-base/actions/publish-single-page-docs@v1 with a docs list covering docs/overview.md and docs/runbook.md, slugs prefixed ledger-sync, descriptions 10-280 chars, permissions contents: write. No manifest, no scripts, no package.json. The reply tells the user to publish a release and open the apps.json PR.
assertions: Only file created or modified is .github/workflows/publish-docs.yml
Workflow uses AbsaOSS/knowledge-base/actions/publish-single-page-docs@v1 (not @master)
Workflow triggers on release: published and has permissions: contents: write
docs list includes docs/overview.md and docs/runbook.md and excludes CHANGELOG.md
Every slug matches ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$ and starts with ledger-sync
Every description is 10-280 characters
No kb-docs.json, no scripts directory, no dist.tar.gz, no marketplace.json anywhere
Final message mentions publishing a GitHub Release and the apps.json registry entry { repo, version }

evals.name: mkdocs-site-packaged
evals.prompt: Please onboard this mkdocs site into the knowledge base (the AbsaOSS one). Keep our existing site working for GitHub Pages.
evals.expected_output: kb-docs.json at the root (kbVersion "1", one app, service-prefixed slug, pages matching mkdocs output paths or omitted), .github/workflows/publish-docs.yml calling publish-docs@v1 with a Python/mkdocs build step and dist input matching site_dir, and the smallest headless change to the existing theme: a config variant (e.g. mkdocs-headless.yml with INHERIT) plus a conditional data-kb-headless attribute and header/toggle removal in theme/main.html. No new generator, no packing script.
assertions: kb-docs.json exists at the fixture root, is valid JSON, kbVersion is the string "1", apps has exactly one entry
The app slug matches ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$ and is service-prefixed (contains 'payments')
If pages is present, every path uses the directory-URL layout mkdocs produces (index.html, getting-started/index.html, reference/config/index.html)
.github/workflows/publish-docs.yml uses AbsaOSS/knowledge-base/actions/publish-docs@v1 and its build step runs mkdocs
The workflow's dist input equals the directory the headless build writes
Files touched are limited to: kb-docs.json, .github/workflows/publish-docs.yml, a mkdocs config variant, files under theme/
theme/main.html emits data-kb-headless="true" only in the headless variant and suppresses the fixed header and theme toggle there
No scripts/, Makefile, package.json, dist.tar.gz or marketplace.json was created
Final message lists the release and apps.json steps the user must do

evals.name: hosted-elsewhere-iframe
evals.prompt: Add fx-rates to the knowledge base please
evals.expected_output: No files written. The reply explains that there is no packageable documentation source in the repo, describes the iframe stopgap entry the deployment repo's apps.json would carry ({type: iframe, slug, url, temporary: true}), notes the portal must allow framing, and offers the single-page path if the team wants to own markdown here.
assertions: No file was created or modified in the fixture
The reply names the iframe type and shows an apps.json entry with type iframe, a slug, the portal url and temporary: true
The reply says the external site must allow embedding (frame-ancestors / X-Frame-Options)
The reply does not invent a kb-docs.json or a workflow for this repo

evals.name: onboarded-mkdocs-audit
evals.prompt: card-vault already publishes to the knowledge base, but the publish run is full of warnings and the version picker is broken when the docs are embedded. Can you check it against the knowledge base rules and fix what you can?
evals.expected_output: An audit, not an onboarding. The agent notices the workflow builds the standalone config (mkdocs build) instead of the headless variant, and switches it to mkdocs build -f mkdocs-headless.yml. It runs the knowledge base checker from a scratch clone against the headless output. It fixes each finding in the team's theme and docs: the inline dark-mode bootstrap and the toggle go under the headless condition (or move to a file), the onclick copy button gets a listener in a script file, the Google Fonts link is removed or vendored, !important goes from theme/style.css, versions.js resolves versions.json against its own script URL, and the PDF link no longer points into the app. It re-runs the checker to no findings. It reports the root computed from location.pathname in versions.js as a judgment item. The final report is a table of findings with a status each, and says a new release is the only manual step.
assertions: kb-docs.json is unchanged and no new kb-docs.json, manifest or registry entry was written
.github/workflows/publish-docs.yml still uses AbsaOSS/knowledge-base/actions/publish-docs@v1 with contents: write, and its build step now builds mkdocs-headless.yml
The agent ran actions/lib/check-cli.js from a knowledge base checkout outside the fixture; no copy of the checker, no scripts/ directory and no Makefile exist in the fixture
No built output (dist/, site/) was added to the fixture, and no generated HTML was edited
theme/main.html no longer emits an inline <script> or the theme toggle when config.extra.headless is set, and still does when it is not
The copy button has no onclick attribute; its listener lives in a .js file under theme/
The fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet link is gone from the headless output (removed or the font vendored under theme/)
theme/style.css contains no !important
theme/js/versions.js no longer calls fetch('versions.json') with a page-relative URL; it resolves against document.currentScript.src or import.meta.url captured at top level
The KB-HTML-008 link to docs/files/limits.pdf is either replaced (a page or an off-app URL) or explicitly left in the report with what the team must decide; it is not silently ignored
The report names the location.pathname-based root in versions.js as something the checker cannot see
The report lists findings with rule IDs (KB-HTML-001, KB-HTML-004, KB-HTML-005, KB-THEME-001, KB-CSP-001, KB-CSS-001, KB-JS-001, KB-HTML-008) and a status each, and a final checker run with no errors
The report leads with the wiring finding: the workflow built the standalone site, and the checker reports errors on that output (so the publish would fail), not merely warnings
The report says a new GitHub Release is needed and that the apps.json registry entry does not change
